name: Mary de Winton
story: Mary de Winton worked in freshwater research at NIWA’s Hamilton office. In September 2004 she and Don Robertson published an account of NIWA’s Freshwater Biodata Information System (FBIS). The system brought together records of fish, invertebrates, aquatic plants and other freshwater organisms that had been collected over many decades.

FBIS supported searches by organism, sampling details and location, including catchments, river reaches and areas selected on a web map. Their article distinguished the working FBIS service from Freshwater Information New Zealand (FINZ), a broader information system then under development that would use NIWA’s River Environment Classification to link biodiversity and environmental data.
